From: S1
To: S2

Strength: 0.95

  upstream_output:

    data_type: "text/list"
    producer_steps: [0, 1]

  downstream_usage:

The Subtask Name: Initial Task Analysis and First Search Execution
Agents:
- Agent: Planner

  -- Observation: Task is to determine the color of clothing worn during Oranjegekte/Koningsdag.
  -- Thought: Need to verify the color (expected orange) with credible sources.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to perform specific searches and extract information.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: WebSurfer Initial Search and Result Analysis
Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Performed search "Koningsdag clothing color orange Netherlands".
  -- Observation: Found Must See Holland page stating "King's Day Dress Code Orange... Everyone dresses up in orange".
  -- Thought: Initial search confirms orange is the expected color; need to verify with more sources.
  -- Result: Reported findings to Planner.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: Secondary Search Planning and Execution
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed WebSurfer's initial results and planned further searches.
  -- Observation: Must See Holland confirms orange; need official/credible sources.
  -- Thought: Prioritize official sites (koningsdag.nl, holland.com) and government sources.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to run specific site: and general searches.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Confirmed plan and prepared to run searches.
  -- Observation: Planner's instructions were clear.
  -- Thought: Ready to execute the planned searches.
  -- Result: Confirmed readiness to proceed.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: Official Source Search and Failure Handling
Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched "site:koningsdag.nl dress code orange".
  -- Observation: No results found on koningsdag.nl for this query.
  -- Thought: Official site may not have explicit "dress code" language; need alternative sources.
  -- Result: Reported failure to Planner.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed WebSurfer's failure and adjusted strategy.
  -- Observation: No explicit official dress code found on koningsdag.nl.
  -- Thought: Broaden search to government sites (rijksoverheid.nl) and general credible sources.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to run new searches.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: Broad Search Execution and Consensus Verification
Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched "Koningsdag national colors clothing".
  -- Observation: Found images of people in orange and references to orange as the national color.
  -- Thought: Confirms orange is the dominant color; need to check Holland.com and other sources.
  -- Result: Reported findings to Planner.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed WebSurfer's results and planned further searches.
  -- Observation: General consensus on orange; Holland.com likely to confirm.
  -- Thought: Run Holland.com search and other queries to solidify consensus.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to run specific searches.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched "Holland.com Koningsdag orange dress".
  -- Observation: Holland.com states "On 27 April, wear something orange and celebrate...".
  -- Thought: Holland.com confirms orange as the expected color.
  -- Result: Reported findings to Planner.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: Final Search Consolidation and Summary Preparation
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed all WebSurfer results and prepared final instructions.
  -- Observation: Multiple sources (Must See Holland, Holland.com, images) confirm orange.
  -- Thought: Consolidate findings and prepare for final summary.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to run final set of searches and prepare summary.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Ran final set of searches ("Koningsdag clothing color orange Netherlands", etc.).
  -- Observation: Repeatedly found Must See Holland and other sources confirming orange.
  -- Thought: Consensus is strong; prepare final summary.
  -- Result: Reported findings to Planner.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: Final Analysis and Conclusion Formulation
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed all WebSurfer results and formulated final conclusion.
  -- Observation: All credible sources (Must See Holland, Holland.com, images) confirm orange.
  -- Thought: Orange is the correct answer; no conflicting evidence found.
  -- Result: Concluded that people wear orange clothing during Oranjegekte/Koningsdag.
Data_Flow: []

The Subtask Name: Initial Task Analysis and First Search Execution

  To_agent: Planner

  agent_strength: 0.95
